name: Deathmark Gauntlet
body:
Aura strong necromancy; CL 11th; Slot hands; Price 30,000 gp; Weight 0.5 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This jet-black spiked gauntlet has long clawed fingers and is detailed to resemble a skeletal hand.

The deathmark gauntlet functions as a +2 spiked gauntlet and also allows the wearer to cast finger of death once per day using their character level as the caster level, with a save DC of 19.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells finger of death; Price 15,000 gp
